beats.script: He said GLP-1 meds can slow down how fast your stomach empties. Like your stomach normally contracts to push food through, and when that slows down everything just backs up. Food, waste, gas. That's where the backed-up bloated feeling is actually coming from. It wasn't a weight thing at all. It was the gut slowdown.
beats.emotion: UMP — Explain in her own voice, then land the personal realization.
